neighbours.label: a verb of pointing to evidence or a referent ('Supporters point to', 'Speed refers to', 'judging by', 'gave an example')
fire: Critics point to the rising cost of rent in the capital.
In this manual, latency refers to the delay before a reply.
Economists point to falling exports as the main cause.
Here the word bandwidth refers to the width of a filter.
Defenders of the plan point to lower crime in the pilot towns.
The term biomass refers to the total weight of living things.
Doctors point to better diets as one reason for longer lives.
In chess, tempo refers to a single move gained or lost.
